citations.citation: For a visionary, densely patterned prose and poetry in Romanian that build the body, memory and dream into an encyclopedic imaginative cosmos and renew the means of the novel.
For a visionary, densely patterned Romanian prose in which memory, the body and dream become an encyclopedic metaphysical project, renewing the novel's imaginative and formal means.
For a visionary Romanian prose, grounded in poetry, in which memory, the body and dream are built into a sustained metaphysical architecture that renews the means of the novel.

For a visionary, densely patterned Romanian prose, grounded in poetry, in which memory, the body and dream are built into a cosmological imaginative world that renews the inward and fantastic means of the novel.

For a visionary, densely patterned Romanian prose imagination, with poetry as its ground, that turns memory, the body and dream into a sustained metaphysical architecture and renews the novel's means.

For a visionary, densely patterned body of Romanian-language prose, with poetry as its ground, in which memory, the body and dream are built into a cosmological architecture that renews the means of inward and fantastic narrative.
